result: Workspace-source live Process-worker test passed: 1 passed in 22.28s.
assertions: With the self-hosted Prefect API stopped, the durable dispatcher tick failed before claiming the accepted submission; the canonical submission remained accepted, no execution attempt existed, and PostgreSQL contained no sink row or effect-ledger record.
The dispatcher's local role status reported unusable prerequisites with the bounded dispatch_tick_failed reason, zero in-flight work, and no fabricated ready state.

After restarting the Prefect API against the same PostgreSQL database, one bounded dispatcher tick linked the accepted submission to a flow run; a separate Process worker completed it and the API reported ready again.
The recovered run produced the expected PostgreSQL row, one committed effect-ledger record, one completed attempt, and a successful canonical report.
